summary: Tazewell County tower listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; a second Virginia list agrees on name and county; no build, staffing or fate sources found.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no removal date is given.

evidence.supports: tower called Valley Ridge in Tazewell County at 37.23017, -81.47444, listed as gone
entry sits in the main table of lookout structures
second Virginia list names a Valley Ridge
the Valley Ridge listing is in Tazewell County

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The association's list gives name, county, coordinates and gone status. The Weebly Virginia list gives only name and county, with no status, date or detail. Two web searches gave no build, staffing, fire, removal or access detail for a Valley Ridge tower, and the results that surfaced were other Tazewell towers (East River Mountain, Bearwallow, Chestnut Ridge) that have their own records and were not used. The story is under the 120-word target because the evidence does not support more; nothing was padded. The Weebly page itself does not name an author, so the earlier 'by Ron Kemnow' attribution was removed.
